summary.root_cause: The S5 M2 mutation applied VT target=15% and aggressive DD brake (5/15, min_exp=35%) to an already weak base signal. The flow reversal factor has marginal alpha (standalone SR ~0.4 in run_all.R output), and the overlays destroyed what little return existed. Turnover of 3205% suggests the signal generates excessive portfolio churn — the buffer zone (50/25) cannot contain it.
summary.recommendation: DISCARD this mutation. The flow reversal signal needs turnover reduction first (wider buffer zone, less frequent rebalancing, or stricter holding period constraints) before any VT/DD overlay can be productively applied. Consider: (1) quarterly rebalancing instead of monthly, (2) stronger buffer zone like 40/20 with n_holdings=20, (3) only apply flow signal when magnitude exceeds 2-sigma threshold.
